name: Dead River Company
notes: Researched from public deadriver.com help pages and the myaccount.deadriver.com sign-in page only (no sign-in, no enrollment). The sign-in page is headed Customer Login with Remember me, a Login button, a Forgot Password? link and an Enroll link; the sign-in input's placeholder is Email (observed in the page source), so auth.identifier is email. Paperless is a toggle under Settings > Accounts; notifications under Settings > Notifications; invoices (two years) under My Documents. Automatic payments are described only in the MyAccount terms (older EasyPAY wording: charge on the bill's due date, cancel scheduled payments in MyAccount or via the local office); the terms page did not render for direct review, so autopay is marked inferred and no AutoPay rules beyond the due date are set. Pricing programs (Equal Payment, Fixed Price Budget, Prepaid Fixed, EasyCAP) open around June with enrollment through October, need automatic delivery and 300+ gallons/yr; enrollment is by form or phone, not in MyAccount. Moving/closing an account goes through a Move Specialist at 855-317-4837. No fees or late charges are published, so none are modelled. No guest pay is shown on the sign-in page. Independent review 2026-10-09: sign-in identifier set to email from the observed placeholder. The MyAccount terms page still renders without content for a direct fetch, so the autopay help was softened to what the notifications FAQ confirms (payment scheduled/cancelled confirmations) plus a single reference to the terms; autopay stays inferred.

guest_pay.note: Dead River's online payments go through MyAccount; the public sign-in page offers no guest payment. Enroll in MyAccount with the account number from a delivery ticket, invoice or statement, or call 855-317-4837.

autopay.note: Automatic payments are charged on the bill due date.

autopay_cancel.note: The terms say scheduled payments can be cancelled by logging in, or by asking the local office.

cancel_service.note: Dead River does not close accounts online. If you are moving or closing your account, call a Dedicated Move Specialist at 855-317-4837 or contact your local office.

help.title: Find your invoices and past statements
paragraphs: Log in to MyAccount and open My Documents. Delivery Invoices and Service Invoices are listed there, and you can filter by account or date range. Up to two years of documents are available.
Documents open in a new window, so allow pop-ups or downloads in your browser, and have a PDF reader installed.
steps: Pick Delivery Invoices or Service Invoices.
Filter by Account or Date Range.

help.title: Go paperless with e-billing
paragraphs: Paperless billing is a switch on each account in MyAccount. Turn it on to receive e-bills and e-billing notifications instead of paper.
steps: Hover over Settings and pick Accounts.

help.title: Email and text notifications
paragraphs: Under Settings, Notifications in MyAccount you choose which alerts arrive by Email or Text Message, such as new statement reminders, payment scheduled or cancelled confirmations and delivery notices. Make sure the right email address and mobile number are on the account.

help.title: Automatic payments
paragraphs: MyAccount lets you schedule payments, and you can ask for an email or text confirmation each time a payment is scheduled or cancelled. Dead River's MyAccount terms also describe automatic payments that charge the amount due on your bill's due date.

To stop a payment that is already scheduled, cancel it in MyAccount or ask your local office to cancel it for you. Dead River's public help pages do not walk through AutoPay setup, so contact your local office with questions.

help.title: Pricing and payment plans
paragraphs: Dead River offers an Equal Payment Plan (even monthly payments at the going price), a Fixed Price Budget Plan (a locked price paid in equal monthly amounts), a Prepaid Fixed Plan (pay for all your fuel up front at a locked price) and EasyCAP (a price ceiling that drops if prices fall, spread over equal payments).

Plans usually open in June and you can enroll through October; contracts end May 31. You must be on automatic delivery and use at least 300 gallons a year. Plans cover propane, heating oil and kerosene.
To enroll, fill in the Connect with Our Team form on the plans page or call 855-317-4837.

help.title: Moving or closing your account
paragraphs: Accounts are not closed online. Whether you are moving within the service area or closing your account, tell Dead River as soon as possible: call a Dedicated Move Specialist at 855-317-4837 or contact your local office. They can coordinate deliveries, transfer service and answer equipment or account questions.

extra.intent: Using the Dead River Company website's help pages, find the minimum number of gallons per year a customer must use to join one of its pricing and payment plans. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: You must use at least 300 gallons a year to join a Dead River pricing plan.
